Prepare step by step

  1. Keep every version and identify which draft is current.
  2. Separate written terms from verbal statements and assumptions.
  3. List price, scope, dates, responsibilities, change rules, cancellation and dispute terms.
  4. Ask a Tennessee professional who handles this type of issue about legal meaning before signing or relying on a term.

General preparation and help finding the right source only; no legal advice, deadline calculation, filing, representation or attorney recommendation.
